serverOwnership: Caller-owned, already-live Node http.Server; helper neither starts nor closes it
entry: Approved existing local realpath ownership anchor; HTTP navigation is fixed to derived origin root /
origin: Only literal bound IPv4 127.0.0.1 and its actual explicit integer port; no URL strings or DNS

network.transport: Playwright route.fetch with maxRedirects=0; non-3xx real HTTP responses fulfilled unchanged

red.cause: openIsolatedLoopback is not implemented; existing verified package/browser available

redirectRefinementRed.cause: Real redirect escaped the first-request-only route.continue guard; the separate service-worker assertion also assumed rejection instead of Playwright's blocked undefined registration result
redirectRefinementRed.fix: No-follow real HTTP response forwarding; explicit all-3xx rejection; assert no active/served service worker rather than requiring a thrown registration error

completeGreen.browser: Signed installed Microsoft Edge 156.0.4314.50, headless, Chromium sandbox enabled
completeGreen.playwright: Existing pinned offline 1.56.1; no new install/download
completeGreen.actualHttpResponses: scope.json plus synthetic v1/v2 getProfile endpoints

cleanup: loopback-cleanup.json; owned browser/process/profile cleanup; caller listeners remain caller-owned
limitations: Caller owns consent, strict asset allowlist, hashes, Host/Origin/method policies, maximum 15-minute listener lifetime, and listener shutdown
The local path is an ownership anchor, not a proof of the HTTP listener body or consent
Direct non-3xx read-only HTTP responses only; no redirect support
Page-network guards are not an OS network sandbox or native Chromium TCP evidence
Tested local Node 22.23.4 / Playwright 1.56.1 / Edge 156.0.4314.50 only
No Node24 production, native Azure, IaC, cloud, or Kano credit
